setup.v2.need_pick: Pick the server that holds your library.
setup.v2.need_plex: Sign in with Plex first, or enter the address and token by hand.
setup.v2.ob_done_enrich: Learning your library has started: watched titles first, then the rest. Recommendations get better as it goes.
setup.v2.ob_done_sub: Curatarr has your history and now learns your library.
setup.v2.ob_done_where: Activity in the sidebar shows what runs right now.
setup.v2.omdb_why: Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic scores, awards. Free key (1,000 requests a day) at
setup.v2.pitcher_hint: A second, separate model only for deletion verdicts. Worth it on a 24 GB card; it is another download.
setup.v2.plan_download: Missing models download in the background after you finish; the curator alone is about 19 GB.
setup.v2.plan_ready: Everything is installed. Curatarr adds its own settings to these models when you finish.
setup.v2.plex_address_hint: The address Curatarr reaches your Plex server at, for example http://192.168.1.100:32400.
setup.v2.plex_lead: Sign in with the Plex account that owns your server. Curatarr finds your servers by itself; nothing to copy.
setup.v2.plex_manual: Enter the address and token by hand instead
setup.v2.plex_no_server: The account {account} owns no Plex server. Sign in with the account that owns the server: it becomes Curatarr's admin.
setup.v2.plex_sub: Sign in with your Plex account
setup.v2.plex_token_hint: Plex's own guide shows where to find it:
setup.v2.plex_unreachable: Not reachable from here: enter its address below
setup.v2.plex_waiting: Approve Curatarr in the plex.tv tab that just opened. This page continues by itself.
setup.v2.soulsync_hint: A SoulSync instance on your network: a second opinion on music metadata. Curatarr never starts its downloads; a track you wish for goes on its wishlist.
setup.v2.soulsync_key_hint: The API key is in SoulSync's settings.
setup.v2.spotify_why: Genres per artist, without signing anyone in.
setup.v2.sum_next: After you finish: you pick which library holds what, Curatarr reads your watch history, then it learns your library in the background. That takes hours to days; it is useful from the first minutes.
setup.v2.sum_no_arr: Not connected: no adds, no deletions.
setup.v2.sum_no_omdb: Not set: no critic scores or awards.
setup.v2.sum_no_server: No server yet: go back to the first step.
setup.v2.sum_no_tmdb: Missing: films and series get almost no metadata.
setup.v2.tmdb_why: Films and series: plot, cast, crew, themes. Without it they get almost no metadata. Free key at
setup.v2.vram: Graphics memory of the machine Ollama runs on
setup.view.lead: A few minutes, and Curatarr knows your library.
setup.view.title: Curatarr setup
setup.vram_hint: Detection runs on the Curatarr host. If Ollama runs on a different machine, pick that machine's VRAM manually — the model recommendations below follow it.
shoko.all_found: Every play the sync has tried found its Shoko episode.
shoko.link_hint: Pick the AniDB entry these plays belong to. AniDB keeps one entry per season, and often one per half-season (cour): link the first part from episode 1, then the second from the episode it starts at.
shoko.nothing_matches: Nothing in your Shoko collection matches. Try the Japanese title or an AniDB id.
shoko.pins_done: Pins whose plays all reached Shoko
shoko.skip_title: Not in Shoko (not on AniDB): stop retrying these plays
shoko.unpinned: Pin lifted: the next sync run tries those plays again
shoko.without_episode_hint: Plays the sync could not place on its own. Link a series and season to its AniDB entry, or skip what is not on AniDB. A pin wins over the automatic match; the next sync run tries those plays again.
spotify.drop: Drop your Spotify extended history here
spotify.drop_hint: Streaming_History_Audio_*.json, endsong_*.json or the whole my_spotify_data.zip — or click to browse
spotify.started: Import started — watch the Activity view. The music matcher resolves the tracks afterwards.
